sloka: ततः सलिलमादाय विद्यया परिजप्य च ।सुग्रीवनेत्रे धर्मात्मा स ममार्ज विभीषणः ।। ६.४६.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ salilamādāya vidyayā parijapya ca ।sugrīvanetre dharmātmā sa mamārja vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.46.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Wise Vibheeshana having wiped Sugriva's face clean in accordance with time addressed with opportune words.
